name: Shlink
description: Shorten links under your own domain with visit statistics, tags, QR codes and a REST/CLI API.
compose:
services:
  shlink:
    image: shlinkio/shlink:stable
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    environment:
      DEFAULT_DOMAIN: "${{cfg.short_domain}}"
      IS_HTTPS_ENABLED: "true"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/shlink/data
    restart: unless-stopped
